profile_text.body:
Dell Technologies is a public company, traded under the ticker DELL, founded in 1984 and headquartered in Round Rock, Texas. Its site describes it as a provider of technology solutions, services and support, selling laptops, touch screen PCs, desktops, servers, storage, monitors, gaming hardware and accessories. The site's own framing centers on buying hardware directly and on support for that hardware.

On the AI side, the site promotes Copilot+ PCs, which it describes as combining performance, built-in intelligence and all-day battery life, and points to the Dell 14 Plus, Dell 14S and Dell 16S laptops. It also advertises Alienware systems with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 series graphics and PowerEdge servers for business workloads, described as offering performance, security and scalability. These are marketing descriptions from the company rather than independent assessments.

The company's profile lists a CIK of 0001571996. Its law exposure record shows 125 matters in Texas, with no individual cases named. No specific AI products or MCP servers are listed for it.
